aidem_camp_defy_10.m: Oh, how interesting your timing is.

aidem_camp_defy_100.m: It's where the rail tracks end. West of the Sutdover River.
r: The Sutdover River? Where is it?

aidem_camp_defy_110.m: The Sutdover River flows between Sullengard and Stoutford.

aidem_camp_defy_20.m: Well, you see, we are in kind of a predicament.
r: Oh, you are feeling guility for what you did to the great people of Sullengard and want to turn yourselves in, but don't want to go to jail?

aidem_camp_defy_30.m: Now that's funny. No! Now back to what I was trying to tell you...

aidem_camp_defy_35.m: We are planning a heist, but we need your "skills" to pull it off.

aidem_camp_defy_45.m: We have knowledge of this vast repository of gold and other treasures, but it is well secured under lock and key.
r: OK. You had me at "treasures". Please go on.
And you want me to help you return it to its rightful owners?

aidem_camp_defy_46.m: [Laughing loudly]. Kid, you are certainly as funny as you are funny looking, I'll tell you that right now. Now, back on topic...

aidem_camp_defy_50.m: The problem of needing the key is where your "skills" come in.
r: These "skills" that you keep mentioning, what are they?

aidem_camp_defy_55.m: I was just getting to that. If you would stop interrupting me, I could get to the plan quicker and how you play a major role in it.
r: A "major" role you said. So what, I get fifty percent of the loot?

aidem_camp_defy_56.m: Again with the humor. No, you will not be getting fifty percent. Anyways...

aidem_camp_defy_60.m: Well, before I get into any more details. Hey Alaric [the lost traveler's real name], do we trust this kid enough to tell him the details?

aidem_camp_defy_70.m: That's fair enough. Now let us move on to the details, shall we?
r: Yes, please. I'm getting bored here.

aidem_camp_defy_75.m: You see, we want to get back some of what is ours. What we helped to accumulate over the years. We want to hit them where it really hurts.

aidem_camp_defy_76.m: Well, yes. But not right now. Those adventures are too big for us right now.

aidem_camp_defy_76a.m: I'm talking about the Thieves' Guild.
r: Why would you want to do that?

aidem_camp_defy_78.m: Well, for starters, Umar and his sidekick brother have wronged us over and over again. Keeping all the wealth for themselves. And don't even get me started on the emotional stress and abuse we suffer from at their hands.

aidem_camp_defy_80.m: You know what I am talking about, don't you?
r: I'm not so sure that I do.
Actually, yeah, kind of. Well, at least that thought has crossed my mind once or twice recently.

aidem_camp_defy_81.m: Come on, $playername. Open you eyes. Think. Your are just a tool to him. Something for him to use to accomplish whatever his agenda is that day.
r: Actually, yeah, kind of. Well, at least that thought has crossed my mind once or twice recently.
I'm not so sure, but please, get on with your plan.

aidem_camp_defy_82.m: Anyways... The Guild has a vault. A repository of treasures and wealth hidden and secure in a location just south of Fallhaven.
r: I've been all around the Fallhaven area a thousand times and I've never seen any vault.
I don't believe you. I would have stumbled across it.

aidem_camp_defy_83.m: Oh, trust me, it's there all right.
r: Trust you? You want me to trust you? A dishonorable thief? Where is it then?
Tell me. I want to know.

aidem_camp_defy_84.m: Are you familiar with that vacant house southwest of Fallhaven? The one next to the cliffside?

aidem_camp_defy_85.m: The entrance to it is found inside that house. It's hidden and secured. You will need to find the passage that leads underground in order to gain access.
r: That sounds easy. I'll do it.
I guess I can try and get in there.

aidem_camp_defy_87.m: No. We will be doing that.
r: Then what do you need from me?

aidem_camp_defy_88.m: What I need from you is more of an inside job. I need you to get the key to the vault from Troublemaker without him suspecting any trickery. Do you think you can handle that?
r: Why should I help you? What do I get out of this?
If I do this for you, then I expect to get paid!

aidem_camp_defy_89.m: Oh, you aren't as dumb as you are funny.

aidem_camp_defy_89a.m: How does 10 percent of the total treasure sound?
r: Nope. I will go no lower than 25 percent
I'll do it for twice that amount. 20 percent.

aidem_camp_defy_90.m: Fine! [Shh] I'll take it out of Greedy's portion. He'll never know the difference.

aidem_camp_defy_95.m: We will be leaving this campsite in favor of our hideout. Meet up with me there and you can give me the key then.
r: Sounds good, but where is your hideout?

aidem_camp_defy_alaric_10.m: Well Defy, $playername did let me go after discovering my crime.
r: [Keep quiet about the facts and agree, for now] That's true.

wanted_men.10: Off the main road, southeast of Deebo's Orchard, I've stumbled across a group of sketchy looking men with familiar voices.
wanted_men.15: The sketchy looking men with familiar voices turned out to be the Aidem thieves from Sullengard. They were hiding-out in the woods.
wanted_men.20: While speaking with Defy, I've learned the he and his men have a grudge against the Thieves' Guild and they want to "hit them where it really hurts". Whatever that means.
wanted_men.25: Defy has revealed the location of the Thieves' Guild's vault of treasure - an underground storage unit accessible from the vacant house south of Fallhaven.
wanted_men.30: Defy has asked me to convince Troublemaker to let me borrow the key long enough that I can bring it back to Defy.
wanted_men.35: Defy has agreed to pay me 20 percent of the looted Thieves' Guild treasure if I get the key from Troublemaker and hand it over to him.
wanted_men.40: Defy has instructed me to bring Troublemaker's key to him at their new hideout located west of the Sutdover River, where the rail tracks end.
wanted_men.45: I have talked my way into acquiring the Thieves' Guild's vault key from Troublemaker, but I must return it to him quickly after I am done with it.
wanted_men.50: I told Troublemaker all that I knew about Defy, his men, and the "Lost Traveler", Alaric and how they hired me to help rob the Thieves' Guild.
wanted_men.55: Troublemaker has asked me to help him trap Defy by providing Defy with a fake key. When Defy arrives at the secret vault, the Guild members will be waiting for him.
wanted_men.56:
I gave Defy the fake version of the vault key that Troublemaker gave me. In return, Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker.
Defy then told me to report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold. He has no idea that the key I gave him is a fake.
wanted_men.57: I have reported back to the vacant house and I met Rennik there. He informed me that the Thieves' Guild has apprehended all five men and that they are now in the Guild jail.
wanted_men.60: Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker. Then I should report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold.
wanted_men.65: I have given the fake Aidem key to Troublemaker as a replacement for the real vault key.
wanted_men.70: I reported back to Defy and he rewarded me with 25000 gold.
wanted_men.75: I told Defy that I was keeping the key for myself and plan to loot the Thieves' Guild's vault myself. A fight ensued.
wanted_men.76: I have killed Defy, his three henchmen and Alaric. I really should go back to Fallhaven and talk to Troublemaker again.
wanted_men.77: I've unlocked the hatch leading to the vault. It's time to head down.
wanted_men.80: I informed Troublemaker that Defy and his men are now dead.
